newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY-NATAL CONTINUE UNBEATEN RUN IN CURRIE CUP.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY-NATAL CONTINUE UNBEATEN RUN IN CURRIE CUP.

text.p: Natal duly complete their round of league matches in the Currie Cup unbeaten with a 54-18 (halftime 21-18) victory over Border in East London on Saturday.

Natal, however, were slow to start only putting their first points on the board in the 37th minute, when Wickus van Heerden crossed the line. But having been outplayed in all departments until that point Ian McIntosh's men finally found their feet to ake charge.
Thierry Lacroix turned in a commanding display from the pivot -- he was inform with the boot and some of his breaks were magnificent.
Border fullback Russell Bennett again proved against top quality opposition that he has the credentials to suceed at the highest level.
Border: Tries: Glenn Gelderbloom, Anton Botha, Conversions: Greg Miller. Penalties: Miller (2)
Natal: Tries: Wickus van Heerden, John Slade (2), Walter Minaar, John Allan, Frederico Mendez, John Plumtree, Errol Stewart. Conversions: Thierry. Lacroix (7).
